mostWorthwhile.text: Building the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation connect lipids and outer cells to reduced water loss, while introducing renewal from deeper layers.

leastWorthwhile.text: The attempted epidermis–dermis pairing was frustrating because the apparent anatomical fit was rejected without explaining why the dermis first needed vessels.

surprise.text: I expected to join the two skin layers immediately; inspecting the dermis instead revealed and automatically performed the blood-vessel step.

arbitrary.text: Requiring vessels in the dermis before joining it to the epidermis felt like an unexplained assembly-order restriction, even though the resulting vascular dermis has a clear biological purpose.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it offered more connections between structures and functions. This one made renewal and the gland's route to the surface clear, though its assembly order sometimes felt restrictive.
